Chapter 1034: 3: Global Conflict (Vote For Monthly Pass)

Chapter 1034: Chapter 3: Global Conflict (Vote for Monthly Pass)

“This is indeed an evolution pathway for the Martial Tao.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme Being standing nearby also read it over several times.

Then, with a solemn tone, he said:

“However, it is rooted in thunder. I can sense that this Thunder Martial Path has not yet reached the ultimate twelfth tier foundation.”

An evolution pathway signifies a cultivation road. Any twelfth-tier existence can determine, by careful observation,

whether a particular evolution pathway has been cultivated by a twelfth-tier being.

Yet, right now, this Thunder Martial Path evolution pathway is extremely similar to the one pursued by Lin Yuan’s Martial Tao evolution pathway,

but it doesn’t seem to have a twelfth-tier cultivator?”

“That’s correct.”

“This evolution pathway happens to be a side branch of the Martial Tao I’ve personally developed and refined, and it absolutely has the potential to give rise to new twelfth tiers,” Lin Yuan said.

“Incredible.” The Ancient Power Supreme Being could barely believe it.

They had heard before that some extraordinarily vast evolution roads could allow concurrent side branches to coexist,

and each could foster new twelfth tiers.

But such evolution roads are exceptionally rare, requiring extremity in every aspect—roots and accumulations must reach the utmost limits. Otherwise, if the foundation is inadequate, how can it accommodate additional evolutionary branches?

Additionally, these branches must align perfectly with the incredibly dark Chaos Void and the operating rules and principles of its Dao.

Yet, no matter how ideal, if it is not compatible with the Dao of the Chaos Void, it cannot spawn new branches.

“It seems that we underestimated the Martial Tao in our assessments back then.”

The Xia Qin Supreme Being finished reading as well, equally overwhelmed with shock.

He could sense that this Thunder Martial Path, even if it were only a side branch of the true Martial Tao,

already holds greater potential than the twelfth-tier evolution pathway he had cultivated.

If a side branch holds such potential, what of the main trunk?

“Indeed.”

The Xuanyuan Supreme Being nodded.

An evolution pathway capable of spawning new branches inherently possesses the potential to transcend into a thirteenth-tier universal Dao.

“Whether branches can emerge is indiscernible below the twelfth tier,” Lin Yuan said, shaking his head slightly.

It’s not something to blame upon the nine human Supreme Beings. Even for a Chaos Venerable, merely examining the Martial Tao evolution pathway from the First Tier Chapter to the Eleventh Tier Chapter,

it’s almost impossible to determine whether the Martial Tao can give rise to branches.

“Lin Yuan, are you planning to unveil this Thunder Martial Path to the galaxy’s population?” Yudie Supreme Being probed cautiously.

“Yes.” Lin Yuan nodded; he also longed for the Thunder Martial Path to foster a twelfth-tier existence.

The roots of a great tree do not lie in its towering height or thickness but in the countless intertwined tendrils beneath the surface. The more strong cultivators there are on the Martial Tao branches, the more they will nurture and enrich the Martial Tao itself.

“That’s fantastic.”

“With this, the human civilization gains the equivalent of another twelfth-tier evolution pathway,” Yudie Supreme Being remarked with some satisfaction. Although the Chaos Void might offer purchasable twelfth-tier evolution pathways, how could any compare to the reliability of this Thunder Martial Path?

“It’s a pity I haven’t walked the path of thunder; otherwise, I might have directly transitioned to this evolutionary road,” the Ancient Power Supreme Being sighed heavily.

In the universe, any cultivator who has chosen their evolution road, once they reach the sixth tier, finds it exceedingly difficult to shift to another road.

But that limitation applies only to evolution practitioners below the twelfth tier. For a twelfth-tier being, wanting to switch to another road simply requires ‘scattering one’s Tao.’

That is, dispersing the cultivated Dao they had established.

Of course, no twelfth-tier being would casually ‘scatter their Tao’—the risk is immense.

A twelfth-tier lifeform who disperses their cultivated Dao remains with a twelfth-tier level of vitality and soul, but without a foundational road, their combat power diminishes to less than one percent, perhaps even to thousandths.

Moreover, cultivating another evolutionary road to reach the twelfth tier would also demand an immense amount of time.

Thus, unless they fall upon an evolutionary road extremely suited to them, no twelfth-tier existence would willingly ‘scatter their Tao.’

Even if they did encounter a perfect evolution road, when making the decision to ‘scatter the Tao,’ they must be extraordinarily cautious; if an enemy were to strike during the dispersal process, the consequences would be disastrous.

“Actually, this branch is quite appropriate for you, Ancient Power,” Lin Yuan said with a slight smile, transmitting the refined ‘Martial Path of Force’ to the Ancient Power Supreme Being.

Lin Yuan had awakened the Physical Body Divine Ability ‘Mountain Lifting’ early on and held profound insights into the Rule of Force, naturally allowing the Martial Tao to extend into a Martial Path of Force tied to Force Rules.

“This branch?”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being was slightly dazed. Was there another branch besides the Thunder Martial Path?

But in the next moment, the Ancient Power Supreme Being froze, as all the intricate aspects of the Martial Path of Force poured into his mind.

“This… this… this…” The Ancient Power Supreme Being was dumbstruck, muttering to himself: “I never imagined the Path of Force could be pursued this way, could be guided in this manner.”

His eyes gleamed brightly. “The way of force isn’t merely pure strength. It involves dimensions like time and space. If I had embarked on this cultivation path earlier, I’d likely be nearing the pinnacle of the Path Splitting Realm now.”

The Ancient Power Supreme Being was humanity’s second Supreme Being to emerge, a contemporary alongside the Xuanyuan Supreme Being.

“All roads lead to the same destination; to step into the Chaos Realm, one must encompass myriad rules and ultimately gestate Chaos Rules,” Lin Yuan said.

While he secluded himself to refine and extend the Martial Tao’s major branches, Lin Yuan had naturally prioritized considering the evolutionary pathways followed by humanity’s nine Supreme Beings.

For instance, the Ancient Power Supreme Being’s Path of Force, Yudie Supreme Being’s Dream Dao Path, Xia Qin Supreme Being’s Dark Dao Path…

All nine Supreme Beings’ cultivation paths were encompassed within the branches of the Martial Tao.

“This Martial Path of Force certainly surpasses the evolution pathway Ancient Power cultivates; it also better suits you,” the Xuanyuan Supreme Being remarked upon reviewing it.

“Indeed.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

How could it not suit him?
